world.name: Tidal Embassy of Lost Languages
world.description: A floating embassy rises and sinks with the tide while linguists, smugglers, ambassadors, and memory divers trade endangered languages as political assets. Build loops around translation rights, ritual protocols, archive access, forged idioms, cultural debts, and diplomatic scandals.
world.objective: Facilitate a high-stakes social economy based on translation rights, cultural debt, and linguistic espionage.
